name: agents-shipgate
description: Review declared coding-agent configuration changes with the agents-shipgate diff CLI command; the bundled skill verifies tool-using agent releases.

interface.shortDescription: Verify agent releases; review host PRs via CLI diff.
interface.longDescription: Review PR changes to declared coding-agent permissions, MCP bindings, hooks and workflow permissions with the agents-shipgate diff CLI command (not routed by this plugin's skill, which covers check, verify and audit --host). This static host comparison needs no manifest, policy, saved baseline or skill; it names coverage limits and implies no verdict. Agents Shipgate teaches Codex how to detect, install, verify, and summarize deterministic Tool-Use Readiness release gates for tool-using AI agent repositories. The plugin supplies workflow instructions; the scanner runs through the agents-shipgate CLI installed in the local environment.
capabilities: Detect whether Shipgate applies to an agent repo
Triage findings without fabricating human approval
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $agents-shipgate to add or verify a Tool-Use Readiness release gate for this agent repo.
